sections.title: What needs attention
sections.sql: select * from deduction_attention order by days_left nulls first,reference

sections.title: Root cause actions
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,reference,retailer from action_workload order by due_on

sections.title: By retailer, reason and currency
sections.sql: select * from deduction_patterns order by retailer,reason,currency

sections.title: Disputed deductions
sections.sql: select reference,retailer,currency,amount_cents,claimed_cents,recovered_cents,outstanding_cents,follow_up from deduction_position where state='disputed' order by reference
